title: Artificial intelligence assisted patient blood and urine droplet pattern analysis for non-invasive and accurate diagnosis of bladder cancer
summary: publisher text verifies ResNet-18 analysis of patient/control blood and urine droplet images with diagnostic discrimination metrics; no evidence of clinical utility or external validation.
organization: Koç University Research Center for Translational Medicine (KUTTAM)

evidence.tested: The paper evaluated ResNet-18 discrimination between patient and control blood/urine droplet images using the reported diagnostic labels; no external validation or clinical-utility evaluation is claimed.
evidence.unknown: The image-classification result does not establish external validation or clinical utility.
evidence.ai_role: Uses ResNet-18 to classify patient and control blood/urine droplet images against the study diagnostic labels.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
